

== Japanese Premiere printing (#172) ==
Full original PSA photograph and separate title/lower-symbol crops independently inspected. Title markers: 0; Credits coins: 0; no printed expansion or episode icon. The original source is retained as [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-stormtrooper-PSA-original-20261106.jpg|the source photograph]]. The Japanese free-deployment sentence does not explicitly say your Imperial; the English says one of your Imperials. The Japanese lore calls the trooper nameless, where the English says one of countless troops. Both printed faces have deploy 1, power 1, ability 1 and forfeit 2. The conditional free deployment is separate from the printed deploy statistic. Original printing ID <code>1301_194o</code> preserves the reconciled #172 identity and #166 source history. Citation preservation remains pending; GEMP implementation is not asserted. Base landspeed 1 is rule-derived, separate from the printed statistics and conditional free deployment. [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Decipher Glossary Version 2.0], p. 34, character, states: Characters have landspeed of 1 unless otherwise specified.
